name: Host skills
description: Claude Code skills shared by the Host team. Installable from DevFlow's Skills Marketplace.

skills.name: unslop
skills.description: Cut AI tells from any writing: puffery, AI vocabulary, em dashes, filler, sycophancy. Applies to chat replies, commit messages, comments, MR descriptions and docs.
skills.author: Ricardo Silva

skills.name: poteto-mode
skills.description: poteto's agent style: concise detailed responses, deliberate subagents, unslopped prose, simple code and verified work. Invoke with /poteto-mode. Ships playbooks (bug fix, babysit, autopilot, eval) and helper scripts.
skills.author: Ricardo Silva

skills.name: deslop
skills.description: Digest a slop-heavy Azure DevOps work item into a two-minute read: problem, change, worked example, rules, test list and open points. Also surveys an Epic or Feature. Read-only. Invoke with /deslop AB#<id>.
skills.author: Ricardo Silva
